review_evidence: Inventoried all 497 current primary output/ssr/primitive Rocq files: 385 own common declaration forms totaling about 2,492 declarations. NumberNotations.v, sort_poly_elab.v, simpl.v, nested_eliminators.v, ssr/under.v and primitive float/string/array specifications are declaration-dense formal examples.

The 112 declaration-light files chiefly exercise diagnostic, parser, printing, notation, module and command behavior; they are source-level Rocq programs whose exact syntax and command sequences constitute the regression evidence rather than generated output files.
Directory names such as output and primitive therefore do not support hard removal, and no exact content-proven disposable subset was established.
summary: Retain this Rocq regression/formal-source unit: content inspection shows formal declarations or source-level language/compiler regression evidence, with no exact hard-exclusion subset proven lossless.
